delete.title: Delete this chip?
delete.body: It leaves your inventory and a tap on it stops opening anything. Its past taps stay in Analytics.

details.disabledNote: A disabled chip opens nothing when tapped. Enable it to bring it back.
details.opensHint: Tapping the chip opens this card. You can change it at any time without rewriting the chip.
details.holderHint: Taps and leads from this chip count for this person in Analytics.
details.tapLinkHint: This is the address written on the chip. It stays the same whichever card the chip opens.

addSheet.title: Add chips
addSheet.subtitle: Only chips issued to your workspace can be added.

tap.insecure: Reading chips needs a secure (HTTPS) page.
tap.unsupported: This browser can’t read chips. It works in Chrome on Android; iPhone doesn’t allow it in any browser, so type the serial instead.
tap.hint: Hold each chip to the back of the phone. Its serial is read and added; nothing is written to the chip.
tap.listening: Hold a chip to the phone…

type.hint: Printed on the chip’s packaging or its delivery sheet.

paste.hint: From the delivery sheet. Chips that can’t be added are listed with the reason.

first.title: Add your first chips
first.body: A chip is the physical card, sticker or keychain people tap with their phone. Each one opens the card you link it to.

steps.link: Link each one to a card
